import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags

# Test m3: data-toc-label with entities
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"
result = md.convert(text)
print("HTML output:")
print(result)
print()
print("toc_tokens[0]:")
tok = md.toc_tokens[0]
for k, v in tok.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v!r}")
print()

# Check requirements
assert 'name' in tok, "Missing 'name' key"
assert 'html' in tok, "Missing 'html' key"
assert 'data-toc-label' in tok, "Missing 'data-toc-label' key"
assert tok['name'] == 'Custom & Label', f"name should be 'Custom & Label', got {tok['name']!r}"
assert tok['data-toc-label'] == 'Custom & Label', f"data-toc-label should be 'Custom & Label', got {tok['data-toc-label']!r}"
assert 'custom-label' in tok['id'], f"id should contain 'custom-label', got {tok['id']!r}"
assert '&' in tok['html'], f"html should contain '&', got {tok['html']!r}"
print("All m3 assertions passed!")
